Geographies Served Programs Beach Cleanup Drive Programme District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra The beach cleanup initiative garnered significant success, drawing a large turnout of volunteers dedicated to clearing the shores. Its primary goal was to raise awareness about maintaining pristine beaches and reducing plastic pollution. Equipped with gloves, masks, and trash bags, volunteers diligently collected litter, which was then sorted for recycling. Hidush Foundation, committed to environmental conservation, champions such efforts to educate on the detrimental effects of plastic waste. Collaborating with the Rotaract Club, Mumbai Sky City, and Clean Me Madh Island group expanded the initiative's reach, fostering community involvement. School Infrastructure Development District Palghar Mumbai State Maharashtra District Palghar Mumbai States Maharashtra Hidush Foundation focuses on enhancing the learning atmosphere in municipal, Zilla parishad, and government-aided schools by revamping the infrastructure. Projects include roofing, flooring, toilets, digitized classrooms, and more, all made possible through corporate CSR funding. With 10 schools renovated in Mumbai and Palghar districts, benefiting over 2000 students, the initiative aims to provide essential resources and a conducive environment for learning. The foundation's ongoing efforts strive to uplift education standards and positively impact students and their communities.
